title: Buffy and Ted Lasso Star Anthony Head Has Died at 72
summary: If you've ever watched Buffy the Vampire Slayer, you know Rupert Giles — the wise librarian who helped Buffy fight monsters. The actor who played him, Anthony Head, has died at age 72. His daughters, Emily and Daisy, said he passed away peacefully from pneumonia, a serious lung infection. He was surrounded by his family. "It is with heavy hearts that we announce the death of our extraordinary father," they said. Anthony Head was famous for many roles. Besides Buffy, he was in the soccer comedy Ted Lasso, the magic show Merlin, and the funny sketch show Little Britain. He even played a prime minister in the movie The Iron Lady and appeared in Doctor Who. But did you know he first became famous in the UK for coffee ads? In the 1980s, he and actress Sharon Maughan played a couple falling in love over Nescafé coffee. The ads were so popular they ran for six years! Anthony also loved the stage. He performed in musicals like The Rocky Horror Show and Chess. He trained at a famous drama school in London. His daughters, who are both actors, said he loved his job and always felt lucky to do it. Prime Minister Keir Starmer called him a "true giant" of TV. Fans around the world are remembering him for the characters he brought to life — especially the one who taught us that sometimes, the quietest heroes are the bravest.
why_it_matters: This reminds us that the actors who bring our favorite characters to life are real people with families, and their work can stay with us and inspire kindness long after they are gone.

background_read: Buffy the Vampire Slayer (a classic TV show about a teenage girl who battles vampires and demons) made Anthony Head famous worldwide. His character, Rupert Giles, was the school librarian who taught Buffy about ancient monsters.
Ted Lasso (a heartwarming series about an American football coach managing a British soccer team) became a huge hit and introduced Head to a new generation of fans.

Before he became a TV star, Anthony Head trained at a famous drama school in London. He first gained huge popularity in the UK by appearing in romantic coffee commercials for the Nescafé brand during the 1980s. Keir Starmer (the current head of the UK government) praised him as a 'true giant' of television.
Article_Structure: WHO: Anthony Head, a British actor best known for playing Rupert Giles in Buffy the Vampire Slayer.
WHAT: He died at age 72 from pneumonia, surrounded by his family, as announced by his daughters.
WHERE: The announcement was made in the United Kingdom, though the exact location of his passing was not given.
WHY: His daughters wanted to honor their 'extraordinary father' and celebrate the many roles that touched fans all over the world.

perspectives.description: Fans remember Anthony Head as a warm and talented actor. His role as Giles showed that intelligence and quiet courage are heroic, and many viewers say that character influenced their childhood.

Some people note that he was only 72 and died from pneumonia, which highlights how serious lung infections can be, especially for older adults. This could remind families to take respiratory illnesses seriously.

The article shows an actor who moved smoothly between theater, comedy, serious drama, and even adverts. This career path is not unusual in acting — many stars work in different kinds of entertainment before finding their iconic role.
